raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 14 (ingested 2026-01-19) delivered txn_ts as epoch milliseconds, for example '1768716261000', instead of 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS' strings, so CAST to TIMESTAMP fails. 1768716261000 ms decodes to 2026-01-18 06:04:21 UTC, which matches the ~06:00 daily start pattern of the earlier string-formatted batches, so the values can be safely normalized.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.85, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS WITH t AS (SELECT *, COALESCE(TRY_CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP), CASE WHEN regexp_full_match(txn_ts, '[0-9]{13}') THEN epoch_ms(TRY_CAST(txn_ts AS BIGINT)) END) AS ts_parsed FROM raw_transactions) SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(ts_parsed AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(ts_parsed AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM t WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
